name: page-overview-purpose
goal: Page Overview begins with its short registered description above screenshots while the header stays concise.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Pages need one short purpose paragraph inside Overview above screenshot evidence. Keep the header concise, route details in Contract, and other tabs unchanged.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing entity overview and visual-overview scenarios only assert evidence placement and concise header copy. Strengthen their existing page cases to require the registered purpose before screenshots at current and selected commits across all three widths.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
